title: Purported Deepfake Audio Reportedly Sparks False Claims of [person] Threatening Texas with F-15s

behaviors.text: A purportedly AI-generated audio clip imitating President [person]’s voice reportedly circulated on social media, falsely suggesting that he had threatened to deploy F-15 fighter jets against Texas.
The manipulated recording was widely shared and is reported to have heightened political tensions and spread misinformation.
